column1: # Apache Camel YAML DSL counters (routes, route templates, REST and beans in YAML; Camel 3 and 4,
# Camel K, Kaoto), for a rule with the prompt file-body-ops: one per line, label TAB pattern (Java
# regex). The [ignore] line blanks YAML comments and the body of a block scalar (the lines below a |
# or > that are deeper than its key, past a list item's dash, as deep as the first of them; the key
# stays, an empty scalar blanks no sibling key), so a script or a simple expression written over
# lines does not count. A route counts by its - route: or - from: at column 0; an EIP counts as a
# key, a list item or not ("- to:" and "to:"). "endpoint URIs" counts a uri: key; the short form "-
# to: jms:queue:x" is a producer without one. OpsFactPatternsTest pins every case;
# ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
splitters, aggregators and other routing EIPs
REST verb blocks (get, post, put, delete, patch, head)
